question: The first Tirthankara of Jainism is believed to be Rishabhanatha, who was born in ____________.
solution:
The correct answer is __**Ayodhya.**__

__** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] Key Points__**

__
 
• **The first Tirthankara of Jainism is believed to be Rishabhanatha, who was born in Ayodhya.**
 
• He was born to the fourteenth and last **Kulakara King Nabhi and his Queen Marudevi** in Ayodhya.
 
• He was also known as **Adinatha and Adish Jina.**
 
• According to Jain tradition, there were 24 Thirthankaras, the** first being Rishabhadeva** and the last i.e **24th being Mahavira.**
 
• The Vishnu Purana and the Bhagavat Purana describe Rishabha as an incarnation of Narayana.
 
• The **symbol of Rishabhanatha is the Bull.**
 
• The name of only two Jain Tirthankaras -**Rishabhadev(1st)** and **Aristhanemi(22nd)** are **found in the Rig-Veda.**

** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4f750a2730aad0987b5e719f277ddc90129c657928205c4d3b5aa23049023fa5.png] Important Points__**

__
 
• **Mahaveer Swami**

 
 
• Considered the last Tirthankara of Jainism.
 
• He was born at Kundagrama near Vaisali.
 
• His childhood name was Vardhamana.
 
• His parents were Kshatriyas. Father – Siddhartha (Head of Jnatrika Clan); 
 
• Mother – Trishala (Sister of Lichchhavi chief Chetak). (Chetaka’s daughter married Haryanka King Bimbisara).
